props.title: AI Engineering Skills Map: Building and Deploying AI Applications
props.thesis: The second map names six competencies for building reliable applications out of components whose output you cannot predict in advance.
props.take: Let evaluation and error analysis pick your next move — Ng calls it the deciding skill.

points.label: Know the model
points.line: Tokenisation, context, caching, cutoffs, sampling and tool calling all shape the design.

points.label: Ground it in data
points.line: Vector indexes, knowledge graphs or a semantic layer — match retrieval to the data.

points.label: Design the execution
points.line: A fixed sequence, or a harness that picks its next action; plus sandboxing and memory.

points.label: Let evals steer
points.line: Inspect traces, analyse errors, then choose measures — and evaluate the evaluators.

points.label: Operate under drift
points.line: Monitor real usage, watch for prompt injection, match testing to the consequences.

points.label: Keep the ML basics
points.line: Supervised and reinforcement learning, bias and variance, still earn their place.

narration: Ng's second map is narrower. It is about building and deploying the application itself. [pause] Six competencies. The first is knowing the model. Tokenisation, context allocation, cache behaviour, knowledge cutoffs, sampling settings, tool calling. All of them change your design. Fine-tuning and self-hosting are specialist options, not substitutes for understanding. [pause] The second is grounding in data. Decide what belongs in the prompt and what the model should go and fetch. Match the retrieval to the shape of your data. A vector index, a knowledge graph, or a semantic layer over structured records. Convert your PDFs, HTML and images into usable inputs, and keep those pipelines fresh. [pause] The third is designing execution. Either a fixed sequence of calls, or a harness where the model repeatedly picks its next action. Then sandboxing, memory, and guardrails. [pause] The fourth is the one Ng singles out. Disciplined evaluation and error analysis. He calls it the strongest skill separating A I builders. Inspect the traces. Find the errors. Then choose what to measure. And check your evaluators too. [pause] He adds that the right approach shifts with the project and its maturity. [pause] Fifth, operate under drift and prompt injection. Sixth, keep the machine learning basics. [pause] Prompting alone was never going to deliver reliability.
